events.title: It's time to build your dream car in My Summer Project Together Demo!
events.summary: Summer may be over, but we're bringing you one last taste of sunshine with our game demo! Summer, freedom, and your very own car… Sounds great, right? There's just one small catch: you'll have to build it yourself first!Search for useful parts and tools, take on odd jobs to earn money for components, and explore the countryside if you can't find the part you're looking for nearby.
